issues.description: The template Lecture class provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), but the problem specification (UML and instructions) and the solution expect a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order. This mismatch may confuse students about the required constructor signature and the expected parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the constructor in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java of the template to match the UML and solution: provide a single constructor with five parameters in this exact order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, remove the partial three-parameter constructor so students implement the correct five-parameter constructor as specified.
